# JTBD Interview Analyzer
## Purpose
Break a user-interview transcript into structured insights using the Jobs-to-be-Done framework.
## Triggers
- analyze this interview
- break it down with JTBD
- extract the user's jobs
## Steps
1. Mark every "situation sentence"
2. Extract three elements: situation / motivation / expected outcome, as a JTBD statement
3. Cluster similar Jobs across interviews and count frequency
4. Tag functional / emotional / social jobs
5. Identify unmet Jobs
6. Output an insight report + product-opportunity hypotheses
## Output format
Markdown in four parts: core Jobs (by frequency) / unmet Jobs / emotional-social dimensions / opportunity hypotheses (3, in "if…then…" form)
## Quality bar
- Every Job traceable to a transcript line
- All three elements present
- Hypotheses falsifiable
